faq.question: Is this a crypto news scraper API?
faq.answer: Yes. It returns crypto market headlines as structured JSON you can download or call via the Apify API—no custom RSS scraper to maintain.

faq.question: Which crypto publishers are included?
faq.answer: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, and The Block via the crypto feed preset (up to 50 items from the last 48 hours).

faq.question: Do I need to change any input before starting?
faq.answer: No. Click Start for ready crypto news JSON. Duplicate and enable Only new articles to schedule Slack or webhook alerts.

faq.question: Does output include tickers and sentiment?
faq.answer: Yes. Enrichment adds detected tickers, sentiment labels, and event tags when they can be inferred from the headline and summary.
